notes.title: Dawn of Darkness Update
notes.content:
Greetings to our gaming community!

Though we don't always good in communication, we continually strive to enhance our game, ensuring the best possible experience for you. Your feedback is invaluable, and we can't stress enough how much your suggestions and insights inspire us and shape our improvements. We want you to know, you are an integral part of this story.

Our long-awaited major update is finally here! As promised, we present:

[list]
[*] Starter Airports for all eras
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31779694/50e3d9f7e7a3677c9592fff344f7ee06df34404b.png[/img]

[*] Updated Fuel Management
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31779694/b4bd892f8471e0de73c2d672654f65506972f6c7.png[/img]
[*] Arrival Stack panel
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31779694/5c2ee473c2b682a063d248815b32ab879bf88921.png[/img]
[*] Terminal Decorations
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31779694/96c94a08949a665846aaeec0ae32789e0fac9608.png[/img]
[*] Modern All-in-One Terminal and Modern Remote Gate
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31779694/3c703c7c4682c15b8692e0c59e7f77ce7cab2855.png[/img]
[/list]
Plus dozens of fixes and improvements. Here are some highlights:

[list]
[*] Tweaks for airline capacity
[*] Adjustments for aircraft lifespan, making it more realistic. Cargo aircraft versions serve longer, while passenger ones are replaced sooner with more modern ones
[*] External traffic, including city buses now match the time. We've finally allowed citizens to have something other than those ancient wooden moto-wheelchairs.
[*] All known issues with traffic stuck are fixed.
[*] Parking service crashes also fixed.
[/list]
Now to something we haven't announced before:

[h2]Night Flights[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31779694/55ce8b6396e47be95471ba68856bd7daf1478236.png[/img]
Yes, we've finally done it. With research, you can now unlock the schedule and place flights (that allow it) during nighttime. All machines now have headlights, houses have lit lamps and windows. The runway and taxiway lighting also works at night! And planes turn on their lights in the dark too! We're thrilled to finally present this to you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31779694/2444e853b4393e2f021b7931b1722c0537fec941.png[/img]
Night flights are more than just a visual enhancement. Changes also affect airline policies. Cargo companies now offer more night flights or unrestricted flights. Passenger ones, especially international ones, prefer morning and evening hours more.

[h2]What is next[/h2]
We will keep updating the games and fixing bugs. Keep in touch!

notes.title: Bug fixes and New Features Reveal
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We continue to debug and address issues within the game. You can find detailed changes (not just bug fixes) below. But for now, we'd like to share some new features that will appear in the game on June 30th.

[h3]Improved New Game window and Starter Airports[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31779694/50e3d9f7e7a3677c9592fff344f7ee06df34404b.png[/img]

This will be especially beneficial for novice players. Now, in each epoch, you can start not from scratch but with a small, albeit ready-made, airport. At this airport, all the necessary equipment has already been hired, and all the ramps are linked. You can literally start signing contracts, scheduling and accepting flights immediately.

[h3]Arrival Stack[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31779694/5c2ee473c2b682a063d248815b32ab879bf88921.png[/img]

Many people (us included) have gotten tired of notifications that one flight or another was canceled, even when the flight hadn't even landed. Yes, some situations were due to bugs, and we have fixed them. 

However, often the reason that prevents the plane from landing is game-related. Therefore, we decided to introduce the Arrival Stack feature. This feature is based on real-life practices. If a plane can't land, it's sent to fly in circles in a certain area. Planes that are flying a hold make up the arrival stack. Now information about such flights is displayed in a special panel, which provides additional details, including the blocker. 

And now you can always see what prevents a certain plane from landing. This information significantly simplifies understanding and the process of airport optimization.

[h3]Terminal Decorations[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31779694/96c94a08949a665846aaeec0ae32789e0fac9608.png[/img]

Ever since we released the custom terminal, we've been receiving many requests about the terminal being empty and needing more objects. As we are very busy fixing bugs, we do not have enough capacity to implement a lot of new mechanics. However, we will manage to add decorations to embellish the airport. Now custom terminals will be even more personalized.

[h3]Modern All-in-One Terminal and Remote Gates[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31779694/7245d0f7e5364f1d8287fd250640c67c27d9c54c.png[/img]

The second most popular request related to terminals was about bringing back modern All-in-One terminals. Not everyone enjoys fussing over planning and construction. For such players, we will prepare a new terminal building and remote gates, which (implied that it is automatically) are connected to one of the main buildings. This approach will allow for more flexible and diverse airports.

[h3]One more thing[/h3]

Our primary focus right now is on stability and performance. So, we won't promise anything more. However, we might manage to implement one more feature, which will be a surprise. Try to guess in the comments, it will be interesting to see who turns out to be right;)


Have a good game!
Real Welders

notes.title: Emergency Plan: First Update and Roadmap
notes.content:
Dear Sky Haven Community,

We've been closely monitoring your feedback and are aware of the disappointment expressed due to the bugs you've encountered in our game. We wholeheartedly apologize for the frustration this has caused, and we want you to know that we're not just standing by.

We're excited to unveil a robust plan of action with a series of updates aimed at enhancing your gaming experience. This plan includes both extensive bug fixes and several improvements, and we're confident it will address your concerns.

Today we deliver the first update with fixes for the most annoying bugs. See details below.

The [b]next update scheduled on June 7th[/b], focused on resolving more complex and "hard-to-reproduce" bugs. 

[b]By June 30th[/b], we aim to release our third update, which will be teeming with enhancements based on your valuable feedback. These updates reflect our commitment to making the gameplay experience clearer and more comprehensible. The enhancements include (but are not limited):
[list]
[*] Arrival stack panel: the queue of landing airplanes with their details and blocker
[*] Starter airports for each era
[*] Tutorial fixes
[*] Some other features we will reveal later 
[/list]
We won't sugarcoat it: the negative reviews have been tough to read. But we see them not as a setback but as a call to action. It's time for us to double our efforts, and that's exactly what we're doing.

However, we need your assistance. If you discover a bug and can reproduce it, please forward your feedback and save files to support@realwelders.com. Your input is crucial to our mission.

We believe in the potential of Real Welders and in the strength of this community. Together, we'll create the gaming experience we all aspire to. Thank you for your unwavering support and understanding.

Best Regards,
Real Welders

notes.title: Magnificence of the Sky
notes.content:
Hello there!

After long and rigorous testing, we are now ready to roll out our biggest update yet! A new stage for the game with a new era of aviation.

First of all, we would like to say a big THANK YOU to our community. Your efforts in beta testing this update have been invaluable. This release would hardly have been possible without you.

[h3]New era[/h3]
Meet the heyday of the turbojet era and the massive emergence of large wide-body aircraft. This means even more passengers and cargo. To serve such a large flow, you need a well-established infrastructure. Therefore, we have added more research on modern facilities and vehicles.

Finally, we've added more modern cargo facilities for the past and new eras. Now cargo liners can be unloaded not in a building from 1930, but in a more modern facility with a bigger number of unloading spots.

[h3]New user terminal feature[/h3]
One of the most anticipated features is here. Now you can plan and build a terminal with as many gates as you need. The terminal can be built with a rectangle tool or a poly tool for more complex shapes. The already built terminal can be edited, changing its shape to achieve the required shapes and sizes.

In addition, passengers themselves finally pick up their luggage from the baggage belts. We've also added amenities to satisfy the needs of passengers: Coffee, Newspapers, an Info booth, and others.

[h3]Bug fixes and performance improvements[/h3]
We once again thank everyone who has been with us for these months in the beta branch.

We managed to significantly improve performance (and we will improve it a little more very soon), reduce the size of save files, and fixed literally hundreds of bugs.

If you need more information, please check the patch note [url=http://realwelders.com/2022/09/14/magnificence-of-the-sky-update/]here[/url].

Already working on the next update
Real Welders

notes.title: Intermediate Dev Update #1
notes.content:
Hi there.

It looks like you you've been waiting for an update [strike]a bit [/strike]a lot. And if you're angry about it, you have every right to be. So, first of all, we are very sorry about that. Also, we appreciate your patience and support very much. The community is much better than we could expect. 

Let’s pour some light on the situation and the near future.

As you may know, we are working on the big update which includes:
[list]
[*] Custom terminal building
[*] PAX delivery to the airport
[*] New era 1970-2000
[/list]
Our initial “the final” plan was to release the update no later than February. But we still didn’t make it happen due to several reasons. Some of them are not directly related to development but have a great impact on the team. But of course, the main issue here is that update is still required extra work.

The content is more or less is in the game and works fine. PAX delivery works [spoiler]almost every time[/spoiler]. Meanwhile, terminal building tools generate a lot of situations that have to be handled. Day by day we test and fix all of that.

Yours, working hard, short-spoken,
RW Team

notes.title: Major update is coming
notes.content:
Hello all,

A long time has passed since the last patch. Some of you could think that we are getting rest on vacation😀. This is not even close to reality. We work all these months and are almost ready to present you a new patch, 

There are some minor tasks to complete before delivery. But we can't wait anymore and want to share some sneak-peeks.  

The first and the main feature is the custom terminal building. We used to have it in the very early versions. Some of you could see it in early gameplay videos and in exhibition play demos. 

Later we (temporary) cut that feature out to increase development and deliver a playable stable game.

Now we introduce completely new, remade from a scratch building system, Hope you enjoy this short clip and in-game feature in the next update.

[previewyoutube=90gkRjxO62g;full][/previewyoutube]

Real Welders

P.S. There will be also new era with new vehicles and planes. More details in the next announcement.

notes.title: March update status
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
It is time to give you some new info about the development state. The first thing we have to say is that we still need more time to finalize and test some new features and that we're sorry for the delay, but the update will be on the 9th of March.

Since the last dev update, we finished the new game window (where you may configure your starting settings), improved the new object info panel(where you may see a lot of info about any object), implemented a new building window (where you may manage your vehicles much easier). We also improved the game graphics (better lights, better colors, better post-process settings), finalized a new day/night cycle(now sun and moon have their own trajectories and shadows look better). And of course, we were just polishing and testing the build.

notes.title: The last update
notes.content:
Hello all!

Our sudden update is here. Last month we focused on the big update “Take Off”. The name means this will be the Early Access/Public Beta update. 

Basic side traffic. Pax and resources arriving from the external world. 
Custom terminal building. There will be (yet) limited tools. Though still enough for custom terminal planning.
Internal objects: Entrance, Gate, Checkin, and several booths. 
Playable to 1970. Sunset of the propeller aircraft era and jetliners. 
Some small extra features we don't want disclosure yet. Surprise.

So when?

The year turned out to be very rich in trials. Both global and local, associated only with our team. This left its mark on our roadmap. We had to sacrifice certain functionality that will still be added in future releases.

We are often asked about specific release dates. We avoid specific dates just because we don't want to let you down.

However, we are still planning to prepare a release in 2020Q3! Our backers will be the first to get the build, and if everything goes well the game will be released on Steam!

Real Welders
